title_zh: 确认模型注射课先观察再练习

scenario.label_zh: 确认模型注射课先观察再练习
scenario.goal_zh: 明确示范对象是训练模型，并约定先看示范再接受教师指导

context_zh: 虚构护理模拟课堂。学生和教师确认课程顺序，不涉及对真人进行注射或具体操作方法。
author: author-phase11-b

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Is the injection practice happening today? I haven't used this training arm before.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Yes, but this first session is a demonstration. We won't inject anything into a person.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Will we be able to see the point of insertion from the back row?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: There's a camera above the model, and the image will appear on that screen.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: So I should watch first rather than try to copy you at the same time?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Exactly. After the demonstration, I'll instruct each student individually using the model.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: All right. I'll leave the practice kit closed until it's my turn with you.
